retrievalProfile.description: A split-frame retro layout featuring a photographic portrait on the left and bold condensed typography on a vibrant color block on the right, all enclosed in a thick rounded-corner border.
triggerTerms: rounded rectangle border with color blocks

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition defined by a thick, multi-colored rounded-corner frame that bisects the image into two vertical halves: one containing a portrait and the other a solid color field for display text.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject portrait on the left balanced by heavy display text on the right
Thick rounded-corner border framing the central content
Script title at the top mirroring script subtitle at the bottom
High-contrast color blocking between the frame and the internal fields
coreInvariants: Vertical bisection of the central rounded frame
Use of a thick, continuous rounded-corner border
Contrast between condensed sans-serif and fluid script fonts

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The photographic subject occupies the left half of the inner frame, scaled to fill from chest to head.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The right-side color block with large, yellow condensed text acts as the primary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top script title, move to the portrait, then to the bold name on the right, and finally to the bottom subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: White space is used as an outer margin between the black thin-line border and the thick rounded frame.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Red and Purple used for the primary internal blocks and frame segments
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow for the primary display text
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the central blocks with a muted, vintage-toned photograph.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of high-contrast condensed sans-serif and casual mid-century script.
letterConstructionRules: Display text must be ultra-condensed with flat sides
Script text must have a consistent rightward slant and fluid connections
Metadata text must be small, all-caps, and widely tracked
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ampersand in display text is smaller and centered between names
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact condensed sans-serif for names paired with a decorative script for titles.

preserve: Condensed proportions of the main text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ultra-condensed, bold display feel
Captures the mid-century casual script aesthetic

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square image with a thin black outer border. Inside, place a thick rounded-corner frame divided vertically. The left half contains a vintage 1960s-style portrait of a man and woman; the right half is a solid red block. The frame itself should be purple on the left and yellow/orange on the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, yellow, ultra-condensed sans-serif text in the red block. Add purple script text centered at the top and dark green script text at the bottom. Add small black sans-serif metadata in the top corners.

verificationChecks: Is the central frame divided vertically?
Are the corners of the internal frame rounded?
Is there a script title at the top?

mustRedesign: Ensure the script font does not look like modern wedding calligraphy
postGenerationChecks: Check that the rounded frame is perfectly symmetrical
Verify the script text is legible against the white background
Ensure the condensed text fills at least 60% of the red block height
Confirm the portrait has a vintage photographic grain
recipe.reuseFormula: Split-frame layout + Rounded thick border + (Condensed Sans + Script pairing)
